description: This file defines a generic Orleans grain 'TypedProducerGrain' facilitating stream production, along with specific implementations for int and Apple types, and the 'Apple' class itself. It includes methods for starting/stopping production, handling stream setup, and managing exceptions, as well as serializer annotations.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrain
classes.description: A generic Orleans grain that produces stream items of type T asynchronously, with methods to control production and handle stream communication.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingInt
classes.description: A specialized subclass of TypedProducerGrain for producing integer stream items.

classes.name: TypedProducerGrainProducingApple
classes.description: A specialized subclass of TypedProducerGrain for producing Apple stream items.

classes.name: Apple
classes.description: A serializable class representing an Apple with an integer number, implementing IFruit.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic, initializing production count.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to produce stream items periodically.

methods.name: StopPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Stops the periodic production timer and throws aggregate exceptions if any occurred during production.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the count of items produced so far.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the count of produced items to zero.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers the production of a stream item.

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked by the timer to produce items, calls 'Fire' if timer is active.

methods.name: ProducerOnNextAsync
methods.description: Default implementation that produces a new instance of T; can be overridden for specific behaviors.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Increments production count, produces an item, and logs activity.
